docs.text: One of the most incredible things we've witnessed this winter are frozen Great Lakes, and none have frozen more than Lake Eerie. These pictures by Carlos Osorio will leave you in total awe.
Too cold to go out and take a picture of the lake, here’s one from last time it froze.
We then promptly went down to Lake Michigan to take photos and freeze. Of course. For being 25° with ice patches, it was a pretty great stand in for the Caribbean!
Frozen Lake Michigan. Yes, we braved the -24 wind chill to go take pictures of the lake.
Photos from my first-ever visit to Kingston. The lake was very frozen!
Wish I had pics of the time I was out on lake superior when it was frozen over, most peaceful place ever
Taking kiddo to a small tour of a TV news studio, thanks to the boy, before the library this morning. The lake is beautifully frozen today.
A frozen snowy beach? That’s beautiful. I love seeing pictures of the Great Lakes, they are something that I always learned about, has always seemed so far away (because they are 😆)
Lake Michigan frozen are great pictures especially when taken from the Hancock building.
That is so pretty. Reminds me of the spring I lived on Lake Superior. There was ice floating in the lake until maybe Juen and we would all talk about it excitedly
Have you been to the Great Lakes in winter? I was near Lake Huron in the middle of winter. The lake has ice dunes. So amazing! Wish I had a photo to share.
